summary: Iteration 1 closed the remaining first-class PR monitor adoption conformance gaps with focused regression coverage, durable validation evidence, and redaction of adoption reason text before persistence.
closed_gaps: Validation evidence recorded in docs/awf-plans/ws_23dd9badf9fe4290a51113e7.md after running the focused adoption suite, ruff, mypy, and the broad service/api/cli/mcp/control/node/runtime/scripts unit gate.

Executor/monitor integration coverage now uses a LogStore for an adopted sync_feature_pr workspace, asserts monitor.log and monitor.start, records adoption/monitor reason-code evidence, and proves token-like adoption reasons are redacted from durable payloads.
MCP coverage now proves awf_adopt_pull_request_monitor returns an is_error tool result with a structured PR_ALREADY_MERGED terminal reason code.

attach_feature_pr_monitor.py coverage now directly exercises the default service-managed adoption path, including repo/PR and PR URL HTTP payload mapping, no-auto-merge propagation, bearer token handling, API error reporting, and output token non-disclosure.
